blocks.text: “Pick me. Choose me. Love me,” is what Meredith Grey said to Derek Shepherd when she begged him to choose her over his wife in ‘Grey’s Anatomy.’ It was an emotional declaration in a messy love triangle, but the phrase eventually escaped the hospital halls of Grey Sloan and became a meme in pop culture spaces. Years later, “pick me” carries a very different meaning online. No longer just an earnest plea to be chosen, it has become shorthand for a certain kind of woman: one perceived to seek male validation, often by distancing herself from or putting down other women.
